mcp-server-git (14 tools).name: git_diff_unstaged
mcp-server-git (14 tools).description: Shows changes in the working directory that are not yet staged

mcp-server-git (14 tools).name: git_diff_staged
mcp-server-git (14 tools).description: Shows changes that are staged for commit

mcp-server-git (14 tools).name: git_diff
mcp-server-git (14 tools).description: Shows differences between branches or commits, or across a revision range (main..feature, main...feature)

mcp-server-git (14 tools).name: git_add
mcp-server-git (14 tools).description: Adds file contents to the staging area

max_count.description: Maximum number of commits to show. Must be at least 1.
max_count.title: Max Count

start_timestamp.description: Start timestamp for filtering commits. Accepts: ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T14:30:25'), relative dates (e.g., '2 weeks ago', 'yesterday'), or absolute dates (e.g., '2024-01-15', 'Jan 15 2024')
start_timestamp.title: Start Timestamp

end_timestamp.description: End timestamp for filtering commits. Accepts: ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T14:30:25'), relative dates (e.g., '2 weeks ago', 'yesterday'), or absolute dates (e.g., '2024-01-15', 'Jan 15 2024')
end_timestamp.title: End Timestamp

mcp-server-git (14 tools).name: git_create_branch
mcp-server-git (14 tools).description: Creates a new branch from an optional base branch or commit

base_branch.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA to create the branch from. Defaults to the current branch, or to the current commit when HEAD is detached
base_branch.title: Base Branch

mcp-server-git (14 tools).name: git_merge
mcp-server-git (14 tools).description: Merges a branch into the current branch. Fast-forward only unless fast_forward_only is false; refuses a dirty working tree, and aborts a merge that conflicts, leaving the repository unchanged

source_branch.description: Branch, tag or commit to merge into the current branch
source_branch.title: Source Branch

fast_forward_only.description: Only fast-forward, failing if the branches have diverged. False allows a merge commit
fast_forward_only.title: Fast Forward Only

mcp-server-git (14 tools).name: git_show
mcp-server-git (14 tools).description: Shows the contents of a commit, or of a file or directory given as <revision>:<path>

repo_path.description: The path to the Git repository.
repo_path.title: Repo Path

branch_type.description: Whether to list local branches ('local'), remote branches ('remote') or all branches('all').
branch_type.title: Branch Type

contains.description: The commit sha that branch should contain. Do not pass anything to this param if no commit sha is specified
contains.title: Contains

not_contains.description: The commit sha that branch should NOT contain. Do not pass anything to this param if no commit sha is specified
not_contains.title: Not Contains

mcp-server-git (14 tools).name: git_remote
mcp-server-git (14 tools).description: Lists the repository's remotes with their fetch and push URLs, like `git remote -v`. Credentials embedded in a URL are shown as <redacted>

repo_path.description: The path to the Git repository.
repo_path.title: Repo Path

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: read_file
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file.

path.title: Path
path.description: The path to the file to read from disk.

head.title: Head
head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file.

tail.title: Tail
tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: read_multiple_files
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously. This is more efficient than reading files one by one when you need to analyze or compare multiple files in a project.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: Array of file paths to read sequentially.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: write_file
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning. Handles text content with proper UTF-8 encoding.

content.title: Content
content.description: The content to write into the target file.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: edit_file
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces exact line sequences with new content. Returns a git-style unified diff showing the changes made.

path.title: Path
path.description: The path of the file to edit.

edits.title: Edits
edits.description: List of line-replacement operations to apply in order.

dryRun.title: Dryrun
dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format without writing.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: create_directory
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists. Can create multiple nested directories in one operation similar to mkdir -p.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: list_directory
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results clearly distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: list_directory_with_sizes
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path, including file sizes and summary statistics.

sortBy.title: Sortby
sortBy.description: Sort entries by name or size (default: name).

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: directory_tree
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure. Each entry includes name, type, and children for directories.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: move_file
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Move or rename files and directories. Can move files between directories and rename them in a single atomic operation.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source path of the file or directory.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Destination path for the file or directory.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: search_files
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Searches through all subdirectories from the starting path.

path.title: Path
path.description: Starting directory path for the search.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Case-insensitive glob pattern to match filenames.

excludePatterns.title: Excludepatterns
excludePatterns.description: Optional list of glob patterns to ignore.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: get_file_info
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory including size, creation time, last modified time, permissions, and type.

mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).name: list_allowed_directories
mcp-server-filesystem (12 tools).description: Returns the list of directories that this server is allowed to access. Use this to understand which directories are available before trying to access files.

mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).name: query
mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).description: Run a read-only SQL query against the connected PostgreSQL database inside a READ ONLY transaction and return the resulting rows as JSON.

sql.title: Sql
sql.description: The SQL query to execute in a read-only transaction.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout Ms
timeout_ms.description: Maximum statement execution timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000).

mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).name: list_schemas
mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).description: List all non-system database schemas available in the current PostgreSQL catalog along with owner metadata.

include_system.title: Include System
include_system.description: Whether to include pg_catalog and information_schema.

mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).name: list_tables
mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).description: List all tables and views in a specified PostgreSQL schema including estimated row counts and disk size.

mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).name: describe_table
mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).description: Return detailed column definitions, data types, nullability, defaults, and foreign key constraints for a table.

mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).name: list_indexes
mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).description: List all B-tree, GIN, GiST, and vector indexes defined on a table including index definitions and size.

mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).name: explain_query
mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).description: Run EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, ANALYZE false) on a SQL query to inspect the query execution plan and cost estimates without modifying data.

mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).name: get_table_sample
mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).description: Fetch a deterministic sample of rows from a table for schema exploration and data profiling.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of sample rows to return (1-100, default: 20).

mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).name: list_active_connections
mcp-server-postgres (8 tools).description: Inspect pg_stat_activity for active queries, connection states, and wait events on the current database.

state_filter.title: State Filter
state_filter.description: Optional connection state filter (e.g. 'active', 'idle in transaction').
